idea-plugin.name: Fathom SQL LSP
idea-plugin.description: Fathom SQL language support backed by the repository's Native fathom-lsp server. LSP transport and protocol integration are provided by LSP4IJ. Managed binaries are downloaded from the public GitHub Releases repository with SHA-256 verification and a configured local-command fallback.
